_comment: Principal QA decision vocabulary on -ref.json (Round 2 EPIC-PREP). Additive to docs/epic-prep-topology-contract.json. Playbook step 3c downstream_hints + step 3i principal reconcile. Verifier: epic_prep_verify.py --strict-principal.

downstream_hints_item.coverage_thread: environment_setup | functional_config | mapping_routing | surface_quotes | invariants | backup_eod | dimensions | deferral_only
downstream_hints_item.needs_environment_provision: boolean — CTQA accounts/groups/publish/routing before UI/console proof
downstream_hints_item.needs_dual_account_contrast: boolean — two group/account personas (e.g. ENRG vs OPPT)

verification_focus_proposed_item.statement: 1–3 sentences; Jira-derived primary focus for COVERAGE to copy without paraphrase

principal_coverage_thread_item.title: Human-readable thread title for COVERAGE section spine
principal_coverage_thread_item.required_when: Archetype rule id from archetype_rules[] when thread is mandatory

archetype_rules.requires: principal_coverage_threads includes environment_setup OR obligations_proposed has kind environment_setup

archetype_rules.when: any primary_candidate obligation with kind invariant

archetype_rules.requires: environment_setup thread optional; formula_first downstream unchanged

COVERAGE.use: Materialize checklist sections from threads; copy focus statement verbatim

TEST-PRECON.use: Session placeholders and provisioning paste (step 6 Round 2)

TEST-PREP.use: Persona split bundles and dual-account placeholder paste (step 7 Round 2); see docs/test-prep-principal-contract.json

handoff_table.use: Primary focus seed — copy without paraphrase

CRT-594.verification_focus_proposed_sample: Verify FX_SPOT group-specific bid/ask on named client surfaces, tier/oracle rules per widget, midpoint invariant across groups, and backup/EOD midpoint capture.
